stem_book: A small particle of mass m is released from rest from point A inside a smooth hemisphere bowl as shown (A on the rim; B at angle θ below the horizontal rim line through the centre). The ratio (x) of magnitude of centripetal force and normal reaction on the particle at any point B varies as: (a) graph of x vs θ: horizontal straight line (constant) (b) graph rising from the origin and flattening (concave down) (c) graph falling from a maximum to zero like a quarter circle (d) graph falling steeply then flattening (concave up)
key: a The ratio is a constant 2/3 — the horizontal-line graph, option (a)
reason: options are graphs (figure bbox = option graphs, top of right column); the bowl diagram itself is at page 3 bbox [0.21, 0.9, 0.39, 0.975]
work: v² = 2gR sinθ; F_c = 2mg sinθ, N = mg sinθ + mv²/R = 3mg sinθ ⇒ x = 2/3 constant
